name: Ishiguri Youhei
source:
A male student without any special features.

An average looking male student. He isn't especially good at studies and sports, but has great vigor. Because of his parents' work, he had to live alone in the city they just moved in. Is overwhelmed by the active approach of the city girls wanting to claim his virginity.

[Translated from [url=http://currant.jp/bokunie/index.html#cha]Official Site[/url]]
